qa_pairs.question: What selector switch position is required for the temperature gage function?
qa_pairs.answer: Selector switch (3) should be set to temperature.

qa_pairs.question: How should knob 7 be positioned to set the temperature gage to the blue range?
qa_pairs.answer: Turn knob (7) against left stop; needle of temperature gage is in blue range.

qa_pairs.question: In what portion of the turning range does needle deflection occur for knob 7?
qa_pairs.answer: Needle deflection takes place only in last third of turning range for knob (7).

qa_pairs.question: What selector switch position is needed for fuel gage operation?
How do you position the fuel gage needle to point to R?
qa_pairs.answer: Turn knob (7) against left stop; needle of fuel gage points to R.

qa_pairs.question: How long must you press and hold the starting button to simulate car engine starting?
qa_pairs.answer: Press and hold starting button (6) at least two seconds before releasing.

qa_pairs.question: What happens to the green LEDs when the Service Indicator is turned on?
qa_pairs.answer: The LEDs of SI begin to light up several seconds after switching on (switch at ON). The green LEDs go out when reaching a speed of approx. 600 rpm.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two reset functions available with buttons 8 and 9?
qa_pairs.answer: Button 8: OIL SERVICE reset, Button 9: INSPECTION reset.

qa_pairs.question: How is the time of resetting indicated on the Service Indicator?
qa_pairs.answer: The time of resetting is indicated by a lamp in the pertinent button.

qa_pairs.question: What callout number indicates the selector switch in the diagrams?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 3 indicates the selector switch.

qa_pairs.question: What happens when the simulator is switched off and on again regarding the LEDs?
qa_pairs.answer: LEDs are turned on again each time the simulator is switched off and on again afterwards.

qa_pairs.question: How can the pertinent interval be cancelled on the Service Indicator?
qa_pairs.answer: The pertinent interval will be cancelled by pressing a button briefly.
